note: AxiomProver is Axiom Math's internal multi-agent ensemble theorem prover for Lean 4, used in their research to solve open mathematical conjectures and achieve perfect scores on competitions like Putnam 2025. It is not a public release. Axiom Math's public product is AXLE (Axiom Lean Engine), released March 5, 2026. Sources indicate AxiomProver is the internal capability/system, while AXLE is the delivery mechanism/API providing access to formal verification functionality. No public release of AxiomProver itself was found.
